description: Who holds the role that may change role definitions. Authority attaches to the ROLE (fabric-coordinator); this file names the Linux logins currently recognised as its holders, because the charter guard cannot read another account's runtime binding. An account named for the role (fabric-coordinator, fabric-coordinator-02, ...) is recognised without an entry. This file is itself a role definition and is guarded. `contributors` names a role that may commit, in agent-fabric itself, the paths its entry lists and none it excludes (a rule ending in / is a directory, any other one file), on its own contributor branch; CI reads this list from the base, never the branch (agent-fabric ADR-018 §5 rule 8).

contributors.note: agent-fabric ADR-018 §5 rule 8: the code of the port of the fabric's bash to Python (ADR-040) and its Python tooling, on python-dev's own contributor branch, folded and merged by fabric-coordinator. Definitions stay out: identities/, routing/, policies/ (but the allowlist the port shrinks), communication/, docs/adr/, memory/, .agent-fabric/, .github/, the guards, the lint, the suite runners and the harness pins.
